LanguageData.Raven_Mech_Aegis.label: (Raven) Mechanical Aegis
LanguageData.Raven_Mech_Aegis.description: Once a supreme weapon used by a fallen archotech empire to guard their holy lands. She possesses the exquisite appearance of a human girl, with an outer shell made of top-tier bionic materials that feels soft and delicate, even simulating body temperature and a heartbeat. Now captured and modified by the Raven Fusang organization, this nun-garbed weapon still retains her miraculous medical skills, but her directives are now completely bound to Raven Fusang.
